lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: For today's special lesson, we're doing teamwork training.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Teamwork training...? What does that involve?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: First, could everyone split into pairs?
The students look confused, but do as they're asked.
... I guess I should choose a partner too.
Yeah, we need to show the students how it's done, right?
Nikkes usually fight together in squads.
The most important thing when you're out there putting your lives on the line is teamwork. You need to have each other's backs.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's why we came up with this game. It's a full-body exercise that requires you to rely completely on one other to achieve balance.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's meant to be fun and help you grow closer to each other.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All you have to do is recreate the poses you see on the screen.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: One person gets down on one knee,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and the other grabs their shoulders and does push-ups.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: But if you're the one kneeling, it might be hard for me because you're so short...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: N-nothing. I'll do what I can.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll go ahead and be the one to kneel.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Because you probably need the exercise more than I do.
I grab the shoulders of the kneeling Privaty and start doing push-ups.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Uh, I'm sorry to ask this,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but could you... breathe just a little more softly?
How am I supposed to do that? It's strenuous exercise... *Huff, huff...*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Maybe you could exhale when you straighten your arms.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Your breath keeps tickling my neck...!
It's only then that I notice that every time I go down for a push-up, my face is getting quite close to the nape of Privaty's neck.
It must've really tickled. Her shoulders are super tense, as though she's trying to keep her composure.
Haha! You made a weird sound.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're the one who did something weird!
I remind myself that we're in class.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Looks like the screen just changed. Let's change positions.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now, the person who was kneeling puts both hands on the floor, lifts their legs, and rests them on their partner's shoulders.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And then their partner does squats...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wait, I have to put my legs on your shoulders?!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ein, I'll lift my legs. Could you crouch down a bit?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Nghhh... I can't reach my legs up that high.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Shouldn't I just be the one in front?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: No! I'm older. I'll do the harder part.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: But you're making harder on m...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ugh, never mind. I'll just lay on my stomach.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If it's too much for you, let me know. We can switch.
Privaty's legs are resting on my shoulders.
And right in front of my eyes is... Privaty's butt.
... This might be harder than I expected.
Privaty lifts her legs off my shoulders and stands upright.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, put your hands on the floor,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and your legs on my shoulders.
Obviously, Privaty is much sturdier than I am, but putting my legs on a woman's shoulders still feels...
Privaty grabs my legs and hoists them up onto her shoulders in one swift motion.
She does squats in perfect form.
All I can see in front of me is the gym floor.
The blood that had rushed to my head gradually spreads through my whole body.
With our bodies and minds feeling lighter,
the teamwork training session concludes without issue.
I brace my legs harder against the floor.
In some ways, this might be a once-in-a-lifetime chance.
Every time I bend my knees for a squat,
my vision is filled with Privaty's... uh, suffice it to say, my viewing angle changes.
I can feel strength surging through me!
Privaty's legs fall from my shoulders and hit the ground.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I told you... You were going too fast.
Face down on the floor, Privaty cranes her neck to look up at me.
I can keep going if you want to try again.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Forget it. Let's just move on to the next pose...!
With each subsequent pose that follows,
I feel more and more invigorated,
while Privaty seems to grow steadily more haggard, as if drained of all energy.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ugh... Th-that's it for today's teamwork training.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'm craving sugar... Wanna go get parfaits?
The students stream out of the gym.
We wipe the sweat off the mats with towels,
and together put them back in the gym's supply room.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It was pretty tiring, though. We should probably go get dinn...
I look around, searching for Arcana.
I find her sitting near the wall.
Why are you sitting over here, Arcana?
Arcana hugs her knees and looks up at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm not a big fan of physical activity.
Here, have this and then let's join the others.
I hand her the chocolate I received earlier.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Huh? This is the one I gave you.
I was saving it for later, but then forgot to eat it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay, but you're not supposed to give it back to me!
Arcana laughs, takes the chocolate, and unwraps it.
She breaks it in half and hands one piece to me.
We eat the chocolate together, looking toward the center of the gym.
Following Privaty's instructions, the students pair off and are doing the balancing exercise.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Miss Privaty's really dedicated, isn't she?
She's always serious about her work.
She prepared a lot for this.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Staying up late memorizing all the students' records, studying the schedule and the curriculum...
Arcana stands up and brushes off her skirt.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Now that I've got a bit more energy from that chocolate, I should go be a good student.
Want me to be your partner?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you pair up with the teacher when doing something like this, it looks like you have no friends.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Granted, I actually don't have any friends, but you know what I mean!
Arcana walks over to Amy, who was standing off to the side.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm not very good at this kind of exercise. Could you help me?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: What would you like me to do?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: First, I think we're supposed to do this...
Arcana cheerfully talks with Amy, and they both start the balance game.
Now that Arcana seems to be all set,
I should watch the rest of the class and help out where I'm...
Arcana and Amy are tangled together in an odd position.
I somehow manage to separate the two.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess motivation alone really isn't enough.
How'd you even end up like that...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We were just following the instructions...
I look at other students performing the exercise perfectly.
... They don't look at all like how Arcana and Amy just were.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, are you good at this sort of thing?
Honestly, I wouldn't say I'm all that flexible,
but compared to you two, I'm practically made of rubber.
Arcana brings over a few other students who were struggling,
albeit not nearly as badly as she was.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName} is going to show us how it's done.
A few more students timidly come over to watch.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What...? You're a teacher, though. Are you really allowed to slack off?
There's not much for me to do. Privaty's taking care of everything at the moment.
Privaty is fully engaged in running the class and taking care of all the students.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well, it looks like Amy's getting a partner.
We watch as Privaty spots Amy standing alone and goes over to partner with her.
That means my only responsibility for now is to take care of you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: In that case, I want a private lesson.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, but I'm terrible at anything physical,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: so you should probably prepare yourself mentally before we start.
Arcana stretches her legs out and then attempts to touch her toes.
Her fingertips only make it about as far as her calves.
I'm not all that flexible either.
I sit down, stretch my legs, and grab my ankles.
It feels like the backs of my knees are going to tear...
Arcana quickly gets up and presses down on my back.
W-wait a sec... My legs are gonna break...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, come on. I'm sure this is nothing a veteran commander can't handle. Here I go again... Hngh!
Fighting through the pain, I reach up and grab Arcana's wrists.
I pull hard and topple her onto the mat.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft, what kind of line is that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: How about, "Once I'm done with you, you won't be able to live without me"?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But it made you drop your guard!
While fending off her continued assault,
I start to tickle Arcana's sides with both hands.
Once I'm done with you, you won't be able to live without me!
Just then, we hear someone's foot tapping.
I look around and see that almost all of the students are staring at us.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm not saying you have to be perfect,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but you should at least try to set a good example.
After Privaty returns to the other students,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Heh, looks like we both got scolded.
I felt comfortable and started acting like I normally do with you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're not usually this playful with me.
Arcana smiles and holds out her hand to me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Since we got yelled at, why don't you teach me properly this time,
After class ends, the students all pour out of the gym.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We just need to gather the mats, right?
Together with Arcana, I wipe down the mats and store them away.
You should head back and get some rest.
I notice an odd expression on Arcana's face as I pass by her and grab the storage door handle.
